title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to increase the Life of Project Budget (LOP) for the Project 205670 - Metro C Line Traction Power Substations…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0569, Budget]
[OPERATIONS, SAFETY, AND CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (6-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to increase the Life of Project Budget (LOP) for the Project 205670 - Metro C Line Traction Power Substations Replacement by $63,000,000 increasing the Life of Project from $98,500,000 to $161,500,000.
summary: Increases life-of-project budget for Metro C Line Traction Power Substations replacement by $63 million, bringing the total LOP to $161.5 million.
